notes:
Replication statistics are author-derived primary workbook values, retained without conversion, at supplied cell precision and with their original signs. ReplicationEffect, ReplicationPValue and ReplicationSampleSize refer to the same author-table row. No individual narrative success verdict was located; numeric success indicators were not treated as narrative verdicts. Original full primary paper unavailable through bounded public acquisition. Original values quoted in the replication workbook were not substituted.
Source follow-up: Title and authors verified in the published scanned article; numerical values, labels, caption N, and significance key checked visually on PDF p. 9. Printed metric retained without conversion. Figure 3 measures identity acceptance (versus searching), whereas identity integration is explicitly distinguished as a separate dimension on pp. 998 and 1000. The located coefficient, n, and p all belong to Figure 3; they must not be treated as a match to identity integration merely because the broad locator names p. 9. No coefficient for openness predicting identity integration was established. Replication and narrative replication success are unassigned.
